t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Ignore gnomes that give 0 points and refrain from alternating between s and k. Try other gnomes as some decrease in the amount of points they give.

vb_textbox.text: It is important to keep in mind whether or the points are being multiplied by 5. Ensure you're keeping in your mind what gnomes give you 0 and avoid them. If a 5x multiplier is applied, divide the points by 5 and use that to determine how good that gnome is.
